properties.title: Record-breaking wildfires burned nearly 100,000 hectares in France, interior minister says
properties.summary: PARIS — France is deploying military planes and getting help from other EU countries in the fight against the worst wave of wildfires in the country’s recent history. At the same time, Spain is also faced with massive wildfires in the area of the country close to Madrid. “It is an historic record,” Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez told reporters on Saturday, announcing that almost 98,000 hectares have burned since the beginning of the year. properties.title: Beethoven versus birds: ECB shortlists designs for new euro banknotes
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — Who would win in a fight between Ludwig van Beethoven and a kingfisher? We’re about to find out. The European Central Bank today unveiled its shortlisted designs for the first revamp of the euro banknotes since they were released in 2002. properties.summary: BRUSSELS — EU ambassadors will on Thursday examine a fresh proposal on a sweeping new set of Russia sanctions after Greece again vetoed the measures over concerts for its fuel shipping industry.  The fresh proposal, put forward by EU rotating presidency holders Ireland, offers a credible way out of the deadlock that has held up progress on the package for weeks, two diplomats familiar with the negotiations told POLITICO.
